articles.summary: Is AI for real? Or just hype? This guide breaks down the difference between automation and AI, reveals dozens of specific use cases across every staffing function from recruiting to payroll, and honestly addresses what AI can't do yet (spoiler: it's not replacing your people skills anytime soon). Whether you're skeptical about the hype or ready to experiment, this post will help you identify the high-impact, low-risk opportunities that could give your staffing company a real competitive edge.
articles.title: AI in Staffing: Hype or Real?
